image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a hammerhead shark swimming in dark blue water. The shark is viewed from below and the side, highlighting its white ventral surface and the underside of its cephalofoil. The distinctive hammer-shaped head is prominent, with one eye clearly visible at the tip. Other sharks are visible in the blurred background.
